definitions.explanation: A large body of water surrounded by land. Bigger than a pond ({池|いけ}).

examples.english: We camped with our family at a quiet lake in the mountains.

notes:
{湖|みずうみ} refers to a lake - a large body of water surrounded by land.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {水|みず} (water) + {海|うみ} (sea), literally "water-sea."

SIZE DISTINCTION:
- {湖|みずうみ}: lake (large)
- {池|いけ}: pond (small)
- {沼|ぬま}: marsh, swamp

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖|みずうみ}の{畔|ほとり}: lakeside
- {湖|みずうみ}を{一周|いっしゅう}する: to go around the lake
- {湖|みずうみ}で{釣|つ}りをする: to fish in a lake

FAMOUS JAPANESE LAKES:
- {琵琶湖|びわこ}: Lake Biwa (largest in Japan)
- {河口湖|かわぐちこ}: Lake Kawaguchi (near Mt. Fuji)
- {十和田湖|とわだこ}: Lake Towada

NOTE:
Lake names often use ～{湖|こ} suffix: {琵琶|びわ}{湖|こ}, {河口|かわぐち}{湖|こ}.
